claim: Across both games 13-40% of a town's ground-floor buildings are entered from the street network: E3M1 6 of 15 (0.40), TEDE1M2 0.385, DukCity3 0.37, DukCity1-2 0.20, DWE3M10 0.135, DukCity4 0.13. The facade promises far more building than exists: interiors are 3-8k deep behind 24k frontages.
use: Make roughly a quarter of a town's buildings enterable, and shallow.
